text:
Cara, Dev, Ben, Hana, Elif, Finn, Gus, Ann, Ivo is the only schedule that satisfies every constraint.

- Elif, Finn and Gus are consecutive, because Finn is right after Elif and Gus is right after Finn.
- Ben and Hana are consecutive, because Hana is right after Ben.
- Ben is before Finn, and Elif is right before Finn, so Ben is before Elif. Hana is right after Ben and can't be Elif, so Hana is also before Elif.
- Cara is before Dev, and Dev is before Ben. That gives the order Cara, Dev, then the Ben–Hana pair, then the Elif–Finn–Gus run.
- Ann must come after Elif and Ivo after Gus, with Ivo right after Ann. The Ann–Ivo pair can't sit inside the Elif–Finn–Gus run, so it comes after Gus.
- Counting people, these pieces fill all nine slots, so the order is forced.

Hana is in slot 4 and Ivo in slot 9, five slots apart, which meets the "at least three" constraint. I checked the other constraints against the order and they all hold.

CONFIDENCE: 99
